notes.title: 0.7.3 Item Database, Item Notes & update on the 'Ask Your Supervisor' app
notes.notes:
[h3]Item Database[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45112577/e35c060feabd498db21913a2d72f3190769932cb.png[/img]
Added a new app on the tablet 'Item Database'. Here, you can view every item in the game. Initially, items will appear undiscovered, shown only as silhouettes with '???' as it's name. Once you discover an item, its name and image will be revealed. To unlock its full details, such as whether its prohibited type and which confiscation bin it belongs to, you will need to scan it using the substance scanner.
[h3]Item Notes[/h3]
Added item notes: You can now interact with bag items and click the 'Notes' button to leave a personal note for that item. These notes will also show and be editable in the item database.
[h3]Ask Your Supervisor has moved[/h3]
The 'Ask Your Supervisor' app has moved! - Its primary design was to have it as a helper, not a prominent feature, so you'll now find a "Still need help?" button at the bottom of the procedures manual to access this feature from now on.
It turns out people aren't a big fan of AI as a whole, not just the art creation varieties - as a reminder, everything you need to know about the game can be found in the procedures manual, and by using the new item database. The feature will remain in it's new subtle location for anyone who wishes to use it as an accessibility tool.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45112577/5af9323ad7db2de5d23e9fdb5e170c4e6e6f5d24.png[/img]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
- Fixed a critical confiscation bug which ignored non-prohibited items and would incorrectly tell you they were mishandled instead of incorrectly confiscated.
- Fixed an issue that prevented you from moving wall items that were above the conveyor ends.
- Fixed a bug that still showed 'Fruits & Vegetables' on the physical notice of confiscation note.

notes.title: Introducing 'Ask Your Supervisor' + fixes
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45112577/70d6e68085e3db79bc21d5295ff884fb9035ded9.png[/img]

[h3]You can now find a new app on your tablet where you can chat to your supervisor and ask them game related questions about procedures and general game knowledge.[/h3]
Your supervisor is powered by ChatGPT and is in the experimental phase. It's designed for new users to have a place to ask questions about the games complex mechanics without having to search online, or create posts on communities.

[h3]It may not know everything yet![/h3]
I have tried my best to add as much detail as possible to it's knowledge base, but It's likely I may have overlooked something. If you find it should have answered a question, or did so incorrectly, let me know on discord or by creating a steam community post and I will make improvements!

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Removed an unused binding from the bindings UI which was causing an error
[*] Fixed an issue that would cause the flag button to be reversed in the wall if it was moved from where the windows now are in the room.

[*] Fixed a missing translation in the bindings UI
[*] Fixed a critical multi-confiscation bin bug that informed you that you incorrectly confiscated an item, even if that item has multiple correct choices.
[/list]

Craig.

notes.title: 0.7.0 - Fresh Food, Multi-Confiscation Bins, and A Room With A View!
notes.notes:
[h1]This update brings a major refresh to gameplay systems, accessibility tools, and visual fidelity — all based on community feedback. Below is a full breakdown of what’s new and improved.[/h1]

[h2]Major Features & Overhauls[/h2]

[b]Multi-Bin Confiscation System[/b]  
Engaging, Simulation, and Custom game modes now use a categorized multi-bin system for confiscation:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45112577/55d246c16d1a5ed4eb660410675151a24ecf6015.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Four bin types: [i]Flammable / Fire Risk[/i], [i]Chemical / Toxic[/i], [i]Weapons / Sharp Objects[/i], and [i]Organic Waste[/i]
[*] Items with multiple traits (e.g., spray paint) can go in either relevant bin
[*] Incorrect sorting now results in a penalty (subject to tuning)
[*] Each bin includes an info board with visual examples
[*] Bins move as one in build mode
[*] The small build-mode bin is disabled in these difficulties for now
[/list]

[b]Fresh Food Category Overhaul[/b]  
The former "Fruits and Vegetables" category is now [i]Fresh Food[/i], and includes:

[list]
[*] Meat, fish, dairy, sandwiches, and of course, fruits and vegetables
[*] New 3D models added (more coming soon)
[/list]

[b]Build Mode Improvements[/b]

[list]
[*] Large objects now use grid-snapping (no more clunky physics)
[*] Small cosmetic items still use physics-based placement
[*] You can now move the mail bin
[/list]

[b]Work Room View & Graphics Options[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45112577/d2c64506627053112739166d191b0bbee2305956.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Your work room now features windows and a full view of the airport tarmac
[*] Aircraft will occasionally take off and land outside
[*] New options to disable the outside view or just its shadows (for performance)
[/list]

[h2]Accessibility & Gameplay Options[/h2]

[b]Bag Helper (New Accessibility Option)[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45112577/809192b981df7d8e7bdd9286d2fee6cc1239b51b.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Makes bags translucent when opened
[*] Allows you to see and click through the interior more easily
[/list]

[b]Timer Controls[/b]

[list]
[*] Option to fully disable the in-game timer
[*] Timer now ticks at half-speed while editing your dog
[*] You’ll now receive a warning if selecting a timed game mode
[/list]

[h2]Balance Changes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Increased overall cigarette frequency
[*] "No Smoking" career task reduced from 10 flagged cigarettes to 5
[*] Reworded prohibited item frequency descriptions on difficulty select screen
[/list]


[h2]Fixes & Improvements[/h2]

[list]
[*] Alcohol bottles now appear more consistently in x-ray view
[*] Increased pill container collider size to prevent them falling into tables
[*] Fixed bug that prevented build mode controls from displaying
[*] Fixed bug that stopped zooming out when holding an object
[*] Fixed multiple orientation bugs during object pickup
[*] Fixed bug that allowed some luggage to be scanned
[*] Fixed fidget spinner spinning on the wrong axis
[*] Fixed bug where firearm permits occasionally didn’t show serial numbers
[*] Fixed “More Passengers” event selecting incorrect values
[*] Fixed Russian language formatting issue
[*] Fixed a typo in the promotion UI
[*] Added missing info to the Pilot Duck unlock
[/list]

[h2]Additional Changes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Added SFX volume slider for outside aircraft
[*] Added a toggle to hide UI on the x-ray screen
[*] Added a new developer console for diagnostics ([i]Numpad Enter[/i])
[*] Upgraded to Unity 6000.0.53f1 — shadows should now appear sharper and more stable
[*] Added a rubber duck easter egg (shhh)
[*] Custom passengers have been updated
[/list]

Side Note:
Due to limited willing beta testers on a large update, new bugs may be present, but I will do my absolute best to get any issues ironed out as soon as possible!

Craig.

notes.title: 0.6.1 Firearm serial numbers + fixes
notes.notes:
[p][b]- Added firearm serial numbers to the game:[/b]
All firearms will now have a serial number etched onto the side. You can spot this by rotating the firearm in inspect mode, or by reading the examine text when picked up or inspected. A passenger now requires both a permit, and to have the matching serial number on that permit for the firearm to be classed as "allowed", if a passenger has a permit but an incorrect serial number - it needs to be flagged.

[i]Firearm serial numbers are a small part of a future major update to flagging.[/i]

[b]- Lowered the height on the low workbench table so bags pushed off the conveyor should now be pushed onto this table.[/b](will tweak as needed)
[b]- Added X-ray zoom control to the bindings page[/b], although it is locked for now and only used as reference.
[b]- Fixed a bug that didn't update your level on the career tab app.[/b]
[b]- Fixed a lagg spike when bags reached the end of the conveyor.
- Fixed a bug that allowed passengers to have multiple large blade permits.
- Added a 'What's new' popup on the main menu when important gameplay features are modified.[/b]
[b]- Reduced scoring penalization slightly overall, and by around 25-30% on fun mode.[/b](Will adjust more with feedback.)
[b]- Fixed a bug that prevented the poster above the conveyor to move when you purchase conveyor pushers.[/b]
[b]- Added a standardized wage of £20 at the end of the day regardless of score payment.[/b](slave labor I know.)
[b]- Misc bug fixes.[/b]  I appreciate your patience with the delay of this small update, I had to take some time off in the last month due to sickness and a family get together, I am now back in full swing and am working on much larger updates! stay tuned! Craig.[/p]

notes.title: V0.4.5 - Early career system and save corruption handling
notes.notes:
[h3]V0.4.5[/h3]
- Added the initial stages of a career system. Currently, there is one promotion available, with more planned in future updates. Your first promotion unlocks the ability to purchase a snapshot display, allowing you to capture screenshots of the x-ray view and review them during manual inspections. 
- Introduced save corruption handling. The game now creates automatic backups every 30 seconds and at the end of each day. If a crash causes save corruption, the game will detect the issue and attempt to restore from the latest backup.  
- Added a new achievement for reaching your first promotion.  
- Random events are now significantly more frequent, with the probability increasing from 3.33% to 10% for common difficulties and 7.5% for normal difficulties. Daily restrictions are also more common, from 1/7 to 1/5 for common and 1/10 to 1/7 for normal.  
- Fixed an issue preventing random events from firing.  
- Reduced score penalties for mistakes across all difficulties by approximately 15%.  
- You can now toggle adult toys and explosives on or off from the in-game settings.  
- Fixed an issue where items discovered before the career system did not count toward career tasks.  
- Throwing a ball for the dog now has a tiny delay before the dog reacts.  
- Fixed an issue that prevented the objectives UI from hiding when all tasks were complete.  
- Fixed an issue that allowed players to open the career hub while the radial menu was open.  
- Fixed an issue that allowed players to click through the build mode shop UI.  
- Changed the "Show Controls" keybind to 'J', as 'C' is now used for the career hub.  
- Fixed an issue where custom flight amounts set to 2-3 would incorrectly give 2-4.  
- Fixed an issue with custom airport codes not saving or displaying correctly in save slots.  
- Fixed overlapping buttons with the x-ray key.  
- Fixed power bank clipping on angled workbenches.  
- Fixed a bug that prevented typing the letter 'B' in build mode text.  
- Fixed a typo on the summary page.  
- Fixed a typo in the procedures manual.  

[h3]Career System info[/h3]
I have introduced a new career system which consists of completing tasks to earn a promotion and rewards. I wanted to have at least 2 promotion levels ready for this update, however had run into some issues along the way, and as this update includes some essential fixes and imrprovements, I made the decision to release it with just one promotion to begin with. If all goes well, you can expect to see a [b]custom conveyor system[/b] with the next promotion!

Custom passengers are temporarily disabled with this update and will resume soon!
If you want to become a passenger in-game, head on over to our Discord server and find the #passengers tab!
https://discord.gg/dKJSThefuz

notes.title: What's next?
notes.notes:
[h2]I hope everyone had a wonderful Holiday Season![/h2]
After taking some time off to enjoy Christmas with family, I’m excited to be back and working hard on exciting new features and improvements and cannot wait to provide you all with updates you deserve!

[h3]I've heard your feedback![/h3]
So far, the majority of feedback has been overwhelmingly positive since the launch of early access. However, it's been noted that some of you find the game quite complicated to get started with and a little repetitive.

[h3]Early Handholding[/h3]
While the tutorial provides the basic information needed to get started, it’s clear that the transition into the gameplay feels a bit abrupt.  
[b]Planned Fix:[/b]
I plan to turn the first couple of flights into a more guided experience, offering much more detailed information. I’m even considering adding a "hint" system during these initial two days. This could range from your supervisor pointing out [i]something[/i] unusual in a bag, to physically highlighting items, showing exact examples of prohibited or illegal contents, and explaining why they are flagged.

[h3]Creating a Purpose[/h3]  
I am currently working on a new [b]career system[/b]! This system will introduce tasks for you to complete, such as processing bags or discovering items. Once you've completed all assigned tasks, you’ll earn a promotion!

Each promotion will come with rewards, including tools to assist with your daily work and a pay increase.  
These promotion levels are designed to give you a clear sense of progression and a meaningful goal, rather than simply working endlessly without an end in sight.

[h3]Keeping Gameplay Fresh[/h3]  
One of my key ongoing priorities is to keep the gameplay exciting and varied by introducing new random events and a wider variety of items to discover. These additions are essential to ensuring the experience stays engaging and avoids becoming repetitive.  

I’m also exploring new gameplay mechanics that could add depth and unexpected challenges, creating moments that keep you on your toes and make each session feel unique. Your feedback will be invaluable in shaping these updates!  

[h3]Bear With Me[/h3]  
[b]As a solo developer[/b], I have my hands full with implementing new features, fixing bugs, responding to feedback and dealing with family life. While it all takes time, I remain committed to delivering the best experience possible.  

Your incredible support and understanding mean the world to me. I cannot thank you enough for your patience and encouragement as I work hard to make this game everything it can be - and more. Together, we’re building something special!

[h3]You can also check out the first three stages of the Early Access roadmap below![/h3]  
I’m not necessarily tackling these in order; instead, I’m prioritizing them based on ongoing demand and player requests. Once these stages are complete, rest assured that more exciting updates will follow shortly after!  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45112577/b8c6d29efa197f1e1fb79cccaea209377ca64ddc.png[/img]

Thank you all so much for being incredible!
Craig.

notes.notes:
[b]V0.4.3[/b]
[b]Introducing save slots![/b]
You can now create up to four save slots, ideal for one of each difficulty type. The "Continue" and "New Game" button on the main menu has been replaced with a new "Play" button - pressing this button now brings up the save slots UI.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45112577/c7c48c8b73da63908d41226e6db93b7ffabeab57.png[/img]
Existing "Legacy" saves must be played at least once to show their stats on the save slot.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45112577/40381247d19f13db00ee87bc546fca1b00d5027e.png[/img]

[b]Other Updates[/b]
- The game now triggers an automatic save at the end of each day to prevent progress loss in case of crashes.  
- Fixed an issue that allowed the wall clock to be endlessly resold.  
- Fixed an issue preventing the letter 'F' from being typed when customizing names on the computer.  
- Slightly reduced email subject font size to better accommodate long airport names.  
- Minor bug fixes.

notes.title: Improved preset packing, improvements and bug fixes
notes.notes:
[b]V0.4.2[/b]
- Updated bag presets to appear more naturally packed, reducing the overly "robotic" look. Feedback is encouraged, and further adjustments are planned.  
- Fixed two issues that caused items to fall through bags when closing lids.  
- Fixed an issue that allowed players to repeatedly sell floor text after exiting and reloading.  
- Fixed a bug where the total items discovered could exceed the current maximum.  
- Adjusted the procedures manual: the "Ammo" section no longer incorrectly mentions grenades, which are classified as explosives.  
- Reduced the spawn rate of adult toys slightly.  
- Reduced the frequency of currency spawns but increased the overall amount per stack.  
- Adjusted the scale of currency notes to better match their intended size.  
- Modified the scale of soda cans slightly.  
- Minor bug fixes.

notes.title: Dutch (nl) now supported - Small bug fixes and tweaks
notes.notes:
- Dutch (nl) language is now supported. Please note that the community translation is still in progress and may contain errors. If you spot any, feel free to reach out and let us know.  
- Fixed missing translations in the incorrectly flagged summary info.  
- Added information about "blunt tools" being prohibited under the "non-lethal weapons" category in the procedures manual.  
- Minor bug fixes.

notes.title: Small bug fixes and improvements
notes.notes:
[b]V0.4.05[/b]
- Custom radio station audio files now detect file types instead of relying on `.mp3` or `.wav` extensions.  
- Substance scan results have been improved for better readability and easier distinction.  
- Fixed an issue where the tutorial demonstration bag caused an error.  
- Added the ability to press the 'Return' key to confirm flag selections as an alternative to clicking the green check button.  
- Minor bug fixes.

notes.title: Roadmap Announcement - First 3 Stages
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45112577/b8c6d29efa197f1e1fb79cccaea209377ca64ddc.png[/img]

[h1]There are just 7 days until launch![/h1]
[h2]Introducing the first 3 stages of Airport X-Ray Simulator's early access roadmap![/h2]
[h3]Early access main updates will be split into stages.
[b]Questions and Answers[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Why stages?[/b] - As a solo developer, I need to keep expectations realistic, and I feel doing it in achievable stages is the best route forward.
[*] [b]Will there definitely be more stages to come?[/b] - Absolutely! These first 3 stages are based on poll results held in our Discord community. What comes next is entirely up to you, the community!
[*] [b]Where can I recommend features?[/b] - You can either make a community post here on Steam or you can join our [b][url=https://discord.gg/CaETEJfZeE]Discord[/url][/b] and get involved with the community and chat with me, the developer, more easily!
[*] [b]Can we expect regular small updates with tweaks and bug reports?[/b] - Yes of course! - I will continue to make small regular updates alongside these bigger stage ones with everything from bug reports, to quality of life improvements.
[*] [b]How long is each stage expected to take?[/b] - Depending on circumstances and unexpected problems, you should be able to expect them out at least once a month, sometimes sooner, sometimes a little longer, all depending on how well everything goes!
[/list]
This list isn't definitive either. Depending on how smoothly everything else goes, you can expect even more content to be added throughout!

Love,
Craig.
[/h3]
